quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: Eneva and GE Vernova launch operations at Azulo Power Plant (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Eneva's Azulão I thermal power plant in Silves, Amazonas, Brazil, powered by a GE Vernova 7HA.02 gas turbine paired with an H65 generator, started commercial operation; it is contracted to provide 295 MW to Brazil's National Interconnected System for 15 years. GE Vernova secured a 15-year service agreement and implemented a custom Sub Synchronous Resonance (SSR) blocking filter with a torsional stress relay to connect the plant to the ~1,850 km Tucuruí-Macapá-Manaus transmission corridor.
